model:
Hierarchical lognormal prior for the dive build-up, fitted to the real accident cases and the Boeing 777 simulations.
Classes by crew input during the build-up: 'noinput' (no effective crew input: Adam Air 574, China Airlines 006, Boeing 777
alternate-power simulations 3, 4, 6, 10) and 'active' (crew input during the build-up). Steady descents and stalls do not reach a
dive and inform the non-dive (glide) family, not this kernel. Model per quantity: log y_i ~ N(mu_c, tau^2 + s_i^2),
mu_c ~ N(mu0, omega^2); mu0 ~ N(0, 3^2), omega, tau ~ HalfNormal(1). Random-walk Metropolis. Writes case-prior.json and the
leave-one-out test (pre-registered Test A).
